description: Use this tool ONLY when the user wants to ship a specific vehicle (they name or ask about a car, SUV, minivan, electric vehicle, pickup truck (including Cybertruck and R1T), large SUV or van) within the United States: interstate car shipping, auto transport, cross-country vehicle transport, or comparing open vs enclosed carrier prices. Inputs: pickup and delivery (city + state or ZIP), vehicle year, make, model, whether it runs, and open or enclosed preference. Returns the route, driving miles, open AND enclosed estimates side by side (or 'call for quote'), a recommendation, a 3-day pickup window, transit days and a link to request a callback. Prices are an estimated range, low end first; SUVs, large SUVs, minivans, vans and pickups use our own class carrier rates. Motorcycles, non-running and very high-value vehicles return 'call for quote' with no number. Estimates only, not binding; nothing is booked. Do not call this for a house, apartment or household move (bedrooms, square feet, furniture): use get_long_distance_quote or get_international_quote instead, and do not call it alongside them unless the user also asks to ship a vehicle. Do not use for shipping a vehicle to or from another country, for boats or RVs (motorcycles return 'call for quote'), or for routes outside the US. Modifications: lift_kit, lowered, oversized_tires, wide_body, roof_rack, cargo_box, bike_rack, hitch_carrier, light_bar, bull_bar_winch, spoiler_aero, camper_shell_tonneau, aftermarket_wheels, other. Read-only; nothing is booked.
name: get_quote
title: Get car shipping quote
